name: International Tiger Day
description: Also called Global Tiger Day, established in 2010 at the St. Petersburg Tiger Summit to raise awareness of wild tiger conservation. India holds roughly 70% of the world's wild tiger population.

name: World Lion Day
description: An awareness day for lion conservation worldwide. In India, it spotlights the Asiatic lion, which survives in the wild only in and around Gir Forest, Gujarat.

name: World Elephant Day
description: Launched in 2012 to bring attention to the urgent threats facing Asian and African elephants, including habitat loss, poaching, and human-elephant conflict.

name: World Rhino Day
description: Celebrates all five rhino species. In India, it centers on the greater one-horned (Indian) rhinoceros, whose largest population lives in Assam's Kaziranga National Park.

name: World Sparrow Day
description: Started by the Nature Forever Society in Nashik, India, to raise awareness of the house sparrow's decline in Indian cities and other common birds' conservation.
